Thaw of the Lich Lord: A ten-scenario campaign against the Lich Lord. Adds the Bard, Crow Master, Javelineer and Pack Mule, the Homunculus, Lichdom and Revenant spells, new treasure and an undead-heavy bestiary.
Into the Breeding Pits: Takes warbands underground, with rules for lighting, traps and secret passages. Adds the Beastcrafter, reaction and lost spells, the Trap Expert and Tunnel Fighter, five scenarios, treasure and new creatures.
Forgotten Pacts: Centres on demons: forging pacts through True Names and advanced summoning with demonic attributes. Adds Mystic Brands, new spells, five soldiers including the Assassin and Demon Hunter, scenarios, treasure and a bestiary.
The Frostgrave Folio: Collects five short campaigns: The Hunt for the Golem, Sellsword, Dark Alchemy, Arcane Locations and The Ravages of Time. Along the way it introduces the captain, more potions, new base resources, treasure and creatures.
Spellcaster Magazine: Seven issues of optional extras, among them black powder firearms, horses, knightly orders, dragons, the Rangifer, Legendary Soldiers, monster hunting and Casting Roll Criticals. Each issue also brings scenarios, and some articles are for Ghost Archipelago instead.
The Maze of Malcor: A twelve-scenario campaign in the Collegium of Artistry, opened by a chapter of core rules updates such as Black Market Contacts. Adds the five schools of the Pentangle with their lost spells, treasure, base resources and a bestiary.
The Wizards' Conclave: An anthology of scenarios and mini-campaigns by guest writers. Adds mimics and the unique treasures and creatures that go with each story, such as the Boon of Sargosh and the Blade of Barael.
The Perilous Dark: Rules and ten scenarios for solo and cooperative play: time limits, spawning monsters, traps, clue markers, room cards and randomly generated dungeons. Adds treasure and new creatures.
The Red King: The first second-edition supplement: a twelve-scenario campaign against a demon lord merging his realm with the Frozen City, with reality cracks along the way. Introduces Ragged Warbands, a large treasure chapter including artefacts, and a bestiary.
Blood Legacy: Brings vampire and fire giant wizards, three new soldiers, giant-blooded soldiers and optional rules for high-level wizards. Adds two short campaigns, Eventide Manor and the Caves of Fin Dalka, ambush cards, treasure and a bestiary.
Fireheart: Built around constructs: advanced animation, construct modifications and animated prosthetics. Adds four soldiers, interactive terrain, the Construct Palace scenarios, treasure, base resources and construct creatures.
Grave Mutations: A single d1000 table of grave mutations that figures in a warband can pick up.
The Wildwoods: Leads warbands out of the city into the wilderness, with terrain types, water hazards, weather and supplies. Adds the Guide, Trapper and Trophy Hunter, the Tower of Storms campaign, treasure and wilderness encounters.
Advanced Spellcraft: Reissues the 80 core spells with flourishes, Casting Roll Criticals and notes, alongside a set of optional spellcasting rules. Adds the Bibliosepulchre campaign, its treasure and a bestiary.
